lines.369680623501651973: Don't be scared. It all comes full circle in the end.
lines.369680623505846272: That's everyting one can hope for.
lines.369680623535206400: Take a breath, get yourself ready. Then it's time to step on out. They're waiting for you.
lines.369680623535206402: You'll have to find that out yourself.
lines.369680623535206403: I've done my bit, small as it was. Now it's all up to you.
lines.369680623589732352: I'm pretty sure this is the spot.
lines.369680623589732355: You're digging a hole. Must be looking for something?
lines.369680623589732356: It's not that kind of hole.
lines.369680623589732357: It's dangerous out here, are you sure this is a good idea?
lines.369680623593926656: It's fine. I have to do this. Everything will be all right once I'm done.
lines.369680623593926657: Got a bit further to go before I'm done.
lines.369680623598120960: It's heavy work, but it'll be worth it.
lines.369680623606509571: If there's nothing down there, why are you digging? It doesn't make any sense.
lines.369680623606509572: Don't mean to be rude, but I've got a lot of work to do. This hole ain't gonna dig itself, if you get my meaning.
lines.369680623610703872: I just have to. There's no other way of putting it. Now if you'll excuse me...
lines.369680623614898177: It's starting to get the right size to it now, don't you think?
lines.369680623623286784: Yeah I guess. I can barely see you down there. How are you planning on getting up again?
lines.369680623623286786: What would be the point of that?
lines.369680623623286787: So you'll just be stuck down there?
lines.369680623627481088: Not forever. Sooner or later the walls will cave in and I'll have a couple of tonnes of dirt on top of me.
lines.369680623627481089: Mostly clay, very acidic. No oxygen. A perfect preservative. I'll be fine.
lines.369680623627481090: Christ. This is insane. Just stop it already, I'll help you up.
lines.369680623631675392: No thanks. You're not seeing the big picture.
lines.369680623631675393: I don't think you'd ever understand, so just take my word for it. It's better down here.
lines.369680623631675394: I'm happier now than I've ever been.
lines.369680623635869696: I'm right where I'm supposed to be.
lines.369680623648452609: Eddie Velvet. It’s his last gig.
